spec_case: issue #627 (the failure-resync path, when a prompt's own retries are exhausted)
description: A json prompt with schema: and retries: {max_attempts: 2}, on_error: continue: both attempts fail to decode and both report cache reads/writes. The last attempt resyncs to the node's own failure fields: tokens_sent is null and the cache keys are absent, not carrying either attempt's own usage.
